issue_context.title: goroutine leaks in TestSelectorSpreadScore
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

The ctx object ([line 399](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/selectorspread/selector_spread_test.go#L399)) is context.Background(). Thus, its Done() method returns a nil channel. Later, the nil channel is used to call `wait.BackoffUntil()` and `Reflector.ListAndWatch()` as their `stopCh` argument. The goroutines created in the two functions are leaked.  

### What did you expect to happen?

No goroutine leaks in TestSelectorSpreadScore().

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Run TestSelectorSpreadScore()

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
